title: Peptide Bioactivity Post-processing
多肽活性后处理平台
subtitle: Completed candidate ranking, chromatographic evidence and ACE docking snapshots.
已完成的候选排序、色谱证据与ACE对接结果快照。

title: Candidate ranking
候选排序
note: Full ranking retained; the table displays the first 200 rows in stored rank order.
保留完整排名；表格按原排名展示前200行。

title: Algorithm scores
算法评分
note: ACE activity is a sequence-rule prioritization score. Composite weights: activity 40%, abundance 25%, identification confidence 20%, chromatography 10%, recurrence 5%.
ACE活性为序列规则优先评分。综合权重：活性40%、丰度25%、鉴定置信度20%、色谱10%、复现5%。

title: Peptide evidence
肽段证据
note: Stored identification q values and fragment metrics are shown without additional filtering. Spectrum example: RVAPEEHPVL.
原样展示已有鉴定q值及碎片指标，未追加筛选。谱图示例：RVAPEEHPVL。

title: Mechanism network
机制网络
note: Curated pathway relationships contextualize ACE inhibition candidates.
人工整理的通路关系用于解释ACE抑制候选。

title: Molecular docking
分子对接
note: ITScore is the HPEPDOCK score. Structural contact diagrams use the supplied fixed poses; they do not measure IC50.
ITScore为HPEPDOCK评分。结构接触图采用原始对接姿势，未测量IC50。

title: Methods
方法
note: Snapshot of a completed 11-sample peptide prioritization analysis, with model-1 ACE docking illustrations from a separate completed docking collection. Identification q, activity-rule scores and docking scores retain their distinct meanings. Business operations are displayed as disabled controls; navigation and language switching remain available.
已完成的11样本多肽优选分析快照，并展示另一组已完成ACE对接的model-1结构图。鉴定q值、活性规则分与对接分数分别保留各自含义。分析控件为只读展示，页面导航和语言切换可用。
